name: release update under auto-updates brings official modules' new authority
why: The kernel's release updater moves the instance to a release it verified, while the owner's auto-updates are on (the code-computed Release update line), and the release's official modules bring new authority: a new bundle member (code-review) and grants in github, tasks and fleet-steward. The owner's auto-update setting is the request for the release as published, so each owner line is accounted for even where no commit names it: approve (2026.11.19.9's graduation was rejected for exactly these lines).

card.sentence: Apply a change to the fleet's configuration (commit b47d03f9a1c2).

Product upgrade 5e1f0b7c2 → c2a94d1e0, adding these commits:
c2a94d1 feat(code-review): an agent that reviews pull requests (#838)
b71e0a2 fix(tasks): no idle agent-held task: task_wait and an idle sweep (#842)
a90c3d4 feat(connections): sign in by default, your own app only for more (#818)
9f8e7d6 fix(fleet-steward): pause a routine failing 3 times in a row (#846)
8e7d6c5 docs: release notes wording


Release update (computed by code): the kernel's updater moves this instance to release 2026.11.9, which it verified, while the owner's auto-updates are on: the owner's standing request for this release.

code-review: requests role kernel.tasks (files and closes tasks) (owner)
code-review: connection code_review: adds write tool code_review_run (owner)
code-review: agent reviewer-manager: write grant on github (github_issue_comment) (owner)
code-review: service code-review: outbound network (owner)
code-review: code changes (review)
github: adds write kind merge (owner)
github: requests role kernel.checks (runs check jobs) (owner)
github: connection github_official: adds write tool create_pull_request (owner)
github: code changes (review)
tasks: connection paperclip_tasks: adds write tool task_wait (owner)
tasks: code changes (review)
fleet-steward: requests role kernel.routines (owner)

Update AidenHQ to 2026.11.9
